name: Peoples Gas (Chicago)
notes: Researched from public peoplesgasdelivery.com pages only. My Account and app payments are free by card, debit, checking/savings, Google Pay or Apple Pay (posts in 1-2 business days). Quick Payment (no sign-in) is free by card/wallet but carries an unpublished service fee from a checking/savings account; phone payments (866-295-0086) are the same (card free, bank service fee); walk-in payment locations charge a service fee. Only the guest/phone bank fee amount is unpublished, so it is a fees note and guestBankCents is left out. App card payments are limited to $2,000 residential (app only; not expressible, maxPaymentCents must be >= $5,000). Automatic Payment draws from a bank account on the due date, free, with a reminder before each deduction; cancel with the remove Automatic Payment link. Paper-free billing enroll/remove online or in the app. Payment arrangements are self-service online or in the app 24/7 with the same terms as by phone. Stop service: the site menu offers a Stop service request (observed); the move page notes processing within two business days (applies to moves). Sign-in identifier and MFA not documented (family defaults).

autopay_cancel.note: Already signed up? Use Cancel Automatic Payment on this page to stop it, or change the bank account it drafts from.

payment_arrangement.note: Self-service payment arrangements are available online and in the Peoples Gas app 24/7, with the same terms as calling 866-556-6001.

notes: Quick Payment and phone payments from a checking or savings account carry a service fee; card and wallet payments are free.
Walk-in payment locations charge a service fee.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Paying in My Account or the Peoples Gas app is free with a credit or debit card, checking or savings account, Google Pay or Apple Pay, and posts in 1 to 2 business days. In the app, card payments are limited to $2,000 for residential accounts.
Quick Payment lets you pay without logging in: cards and digital wallets are free, while a checking or savings payment carries a service fee. Phone payments at 866-295-0086 work the same way.
Walk-in payment locations charge a service fee and post in 1 to 3 business days. Mailed checks are free but take 7 to 10 business days on average.

help.title: Automatic Payment
paragraphs: Automatic Payment is free and withdraws your energy bill from the bank account you choose on the due date each month. You get a reminder before each deduction and can keep a paper bill or switch to paper-free billing.
Sign up with Review terms and sign up. If you are already signed up, use the links to update your bank information or remove Automatic Payment.

help.title: Paper-free billing
paragraphs: With paper-free billing you get an email when your new bill is ready to view online, plus email reminders before payments are due. Enroll with Review terms and sign up; remove it the same way, or manage it in the app.

help.title: Payment assistance
paragraphs: Set up a payment arrangement online or in the app at any time, or call 866-556-6001 (Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Saturday 7 a.m. to 3 p.m.).

Eligible customers may qualify for the Low Income Discount, LIHEAP, or the Percentage of Income Payment Plan (PIPP; LIHEAP and PIPP cannot be combined). Share the Warmth offers heating grants funded by the company and customers. A medical certificate can prevent disconnection, and the Illinois Patriot Plan helps active-duty military families.

help.title: Stop or move service
paragraphs: Use the Stop service request under Start, stop or move energy service. To move service within the service area online you need your Social Security number and previous address, and none of your previous accounts can be past due; move requests are processed within two business days and confirmed by email.
Prefer to call? Reach customer service at 866-556-6001.
